product_one_liner.value: ComplyAdvantage provides AI-powered financial-crime risk data, customer screening, and monitoring software that helps regulated organizations detect money laundering and fraud.

pricing_page.notes: The public page lists plans, including Starter Plan and Enterprise.

eng_blog.notes: The technical blog contains multiple practitioner-authored posts about internal entity-resolution ML, extraction pipelines, and Elasticsearch infrastructure.

public_docs.notes: The public developer portal includes documentation for customers, screening, risk scores, cases, and alerts.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The official current-openings board lists no qualifying AI/ML/data-science titles. An undated third-party Principal Machine Learning Engineer listing could not be confirmed as open.

model_provider.notes: Technical posts describe Gemini API fine-tuning for entity-resolution work and Gemini models in an extraction-pipeline hallucination checker; exact model versions are not specified.

compliance_certs.notes: Claims SOC 2 Type I and Type II and ISO 27001 certification, plus GDPR compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Latest financing listed by PitchBook: a completed $16.8 million debt deal dated May 19, 2025. A later report of a December 2025 share allotment could not be verified as new cash financing.

raised_18mo.notes: PitchBook records completed $16.8 million debt financing on May 19, 2025, within the requested 18-month window. No primary announcement for that deal was located.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The official current-openings board lists Account Executive and Business Development Representative positions.

launched_6mo.notes: Launched Payment Screening on Mesh on May 19, 2026, within the requested May 9–November 9 window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: Damilola Payne joining as Vice President of Product was reported on September 21, 2026, within the requested window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Its Manager, GTM Technology job description explicitly identifies these as company GTM systems.
